description: This file defines the interface for the Starboard Accessibility module, providing functions and data structures to access and modify system accessibility settings such as text-to-speech, high contrast display, and closed captioning options. It includes enums for caption styles and settings structures, with functions to get and set these configurations.

methods.name: SbAccessibilityGetTextToSpeechSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the current text-to-speech accessibility settings from the system.

methods.name: SbAccessibilityGetDisplaySettings
methods.description: Retrieves the current high contrast display settings from the system.

methods.name: SbAccessibilityGetCaptionSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the current closed captioning settings from the system.

methods.name: SbAccessibilitySetCaptionsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables closed captioning system-wide.
